World Atlas country-boundary asset

File: countries-110m.json
Source distribution: world-atlas 2.x, https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas
The data represents Natural Earth 1:110m Admin 0 country boundaries:
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/110m-cultural-vectors/110m-admin-0-countries/

Natural Earth data is in the public domain. The world-atlas package's
redistribution license and copyright notice are reproduced in LICENSE.
This generalized overview is not survey-grade and is not suitable as an
authoritative administrative boundary dataset. Preserve the attribution and
license notice when redistributing the asset.
